title: Наброски поз с Pinterest (586 вырезок и листов)

source.name: Pinterest boards (sketch, gesture and hand studies)
source.author: various; per-file pin and discovery URLs are in metadata/ready/manifest.json
source.terms_summary: Images were pinned by third parties; the original authors and their licences are not established. Pinterest terms give no right to redistribute pinned images. Use only as a local soft pose/gesture reference. Most files are StoryArt crops of the originals, so they install only from your own copy (--from-dir); files identical to the original pin image are fetched from i.pinimg.com.
